search.title: Find a player
search.subtitle: Rank, season stats and match history by Riot ID.
search.invalid: Riot ID format: Name#TAG (name 3-16, tag 3-5 characters)
search.emptyRecent: No searches yet. Players you look up will appear here.

profile.noMatches: No matches found for this mode.
profile.rrChartLabel: RR change over the last {{n}} competitive matches: {{net}} {{unit}}. Use arrow keys to step through matches.
profile.actWinsHint: Riot's season data doesn't count placement wins, so losses aren't shown.

stats.perfHint: Riot Performance Score (0–500, patch 13.06+). Replaced ACS; MVP and scoreboard order use it.

match.partyHint: Same-colored stripe: players who queued together

settings.title: Settings
settings.apiKeyHint: Free from api.henrikdev.xyz/dashboard → API Keys. Stored only on this computer.
settings.cacheHint: Deletes API responses on disk; next lookups will request again.
settings.historyHint: Recent searches, favorites and each one's saved matches (shown instantly next time). Removing a search with X also deletes that player's match archive and cache. Search suggestions also come from players in matches you opened; all stored only on this computer.

errors.noKey: HenrikDev API key is not set.
errors.notFound: Player not found. Check the Riot ID.
errors.rateLimited: Rate limit reached, try again in {{n}}s.

local.notRunning: This section fills in while Valorant is running. Open the game to see your equipped skins and the live match.
local.loadoutUnavailable: Couldn't read the loadout. If the game just started, press Refresh in a moment.
local.noMatchHint: You're not in a match or agent select. Press Refresh once the match starts.
local.error: Couldn't read data from the Riot Client:
local.allSkinsHint: Every weapon skin, card and spray of the player in buy-menu layout
local.partyHint: Same color on the left edge: players queued together (your party and your friends; other enemies' parties aren't exposed by Riot)

mates.title: Played With
mates.empty: No players in the loaded matches. The list fills as you load more matches.
mates.explain: Everyone you shared a match with in the last {{n}} loaded matches (teammates and opponents). "Together / Matches": matches queued together / total matches shared — click to open them. Henrik doesn't return the full history at once, so "Load more" grows the sample.
mates.togetherTitle: Met in {{met}} matches, queued together in {{together}} — view matches
mates.sharedHint: From the last {{n}} loaded matches. Load more below for older ones.
mates.notInLoaded: This player isn't in the loaded matches. Load more matches and try again.

gs.title: Game Settings
gs.intro: Settings of every Valorant account that has signed in on this PC. Copy them between accounts, save presets, and apply one automatically to the next account that signs in.

client.closed: Riot Client is closed, showing the copies saved on this PC

gs.noAccounts: No Valorant account folders found on this PC.
gs.findNamesHint: Unknown accounts are looked up on HenrikDev a few seconds apart and saved, so each is asked only once.

source.localHint: Showing this PC's copy. Keybinds and the latest cloud settings are read when you sign in with this account.

crosshair.addHint: Added as a new profile and selected. Existing profiles aren't changed; an identical one is reused.
crosshair.none: No saved crosshair profiles; this account uses the default crosshair.
crosshair.exists: Already had this crosshair, selected it
crosshair.addedPending: Crosshair will be added when this account signs in
crosshair.deleteBody: Removed from this account's crosshair profiles. Copy its code first if you may want it back.
crosshair.editPending: Saved; applied when this account signs in
crosshair.opMissing: "{{label}}" wasn't found anymore (changed in game?), skipped

keybinds.none: Keybinds are only stored in Riot's cloud. Sign in with this account once to read them.
keybinds.addProfileHint: Creates a keybind profile for the agent, starting from your general binds (as the game does).
keybinds.removeBody: This agent goes back to your general keybinds.
keybinds.catalogHint: Valorant only stores binds that differ from the defaults, so actions never changed on any account on this PC aren't listed. Change one in game once and it shows up here.
keybinds.offlineHint: Keybinds live only in Riot's cloud: changes to this account are applied when it signs in to the Riot Client.

gs.empty: Everything in this category is at its default.

presets.title: Presets
presets.none: No presets yet. Save one from an account below or import a JSON file.
presets.name: Name

auto.label: Apply the default preset to accounts when they sign in
auto.hint: "{{name}}" is applied once per account, right after it signs in to the Riot Client. Sign in before starting Valorant; changes made while the game runs apply after a restart.
auto.noDefault: Mark a preset as default (star) first.
auto.exclude: Don't apply the default preset to this account automatically

apply.title: Apply "{{name}}"
apply.note: Video settings are written to each account's files now. The rest is applied now to the signed-in account and to the others when they next sign in. A backup is taken before every change.
apply.pendingInfo_one: {{count}} account gets it when it signs in
apply.pendingInfo_other: {{count}} accounts get it when they sign in
apply.gameRunning: Valorant is running: restart it to see the changes
apply.localBlocked: Video files of the account in game weren't changed
apply.crosshairFull: No free crosshair slot (15 max), crosshair skipped

pending.title: Waiting for sign-in
pending.hint: Applied automatically when this account signs in to the Riot Client.

backups.hint: Taken before every change, last 5 kept.
backups.needSignIn: Sign in with this account to restore cloud settings

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body: Removes this account's Valorant settings folder from this PC (including its video settings) and everything ClutchBoard keeps for it: name, cloud copy, backups and pending changes. Cloud settings (crosshair, keybinds, audio) aren't affected; Valorant recreates the folder the next time this account signs in.
delete.gameRunning: Valorant is running on this account. Close the game first.

editor.glowHint: The game's menu keeps outlines black; a colored outline gives the glow look. It's written to the settings directly and isn't part of the share code. Last reported working in 2025; Riot may reset it.
editor.fixError: Override firing error offset with crosshair offset

settings.savedPending: Saved here; applied to the cloud when this account signs in
settings.blocked: Valorant is running on this account; close it to change its video files
settings.offlineHint: This account isn't signed in: changes are saved to this PC's copy now and to the cloud when it signs in. Video file settings take effect right away.
